product-header.name: Mixed (3).png
product-header.reason: Bowls of spices on dark wood. Appetising and unmistakably a food company — the current header is a photo of cardboard boxes in a warehouse, which says logistics rather than food.

product-flavor-1.reason: All three flavour thumbnails on this page are currently the *same picture*. This gives the first one a real chips/snack-seasoning shot.

product-flavor-2.reason: Second of the three — sauces, so the row shows genuine variety instead of one image repeated.

product-flavor-3.name: Fastfood (1).png
product-flavor-3.reason: Third of the three — fried/fast-food seasoning, completing the set.

about-vision.name: Mixed (2).png
about-vision.reason: Bowls of spices from different cuisines — a direct match for “bridging global cultures through the universal language of food”. It's also a naturally dark image, so the white headline sits on it cleanly.

about-mission.name: IMG_7307.JPG
about-mission.reason: Hands sifting dried herbs. Food-forward and authentic — matches “authentic products” and shows the craft side of production, pairing naturally with the spice photo on the Vision slide.

history-2013.name: Mixed (3).png (spices)
history-2013.reason: 2013 is about B2B spice mixes and seasonings, so it should show spices. The current photo is a vat of drying herbs, which belongs to the 1996 story.

history-2014.name: Culinary (1).png
history-2014.reason: 2014 is the Presto launch — powdered soups and stocks. Professional soup photography instead of the current snapshot of packets on a counter.

history-2025.name: Flavora category.png
history-2025.reason: 2025 is about launching your own Flavora coffee line — so it should show the actual Flavora range. The current photo is workers sorting packets, which doesn't show the brand at all.
